ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the central fluke body with high-intensity (white) clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered across the lobes; estimated macro ratio of 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white patches at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Significant white mottling and small circular pixel blobs are distributed across the lower-medial and outer regions of both fluke halves against the dark background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, well-defined V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 70 degrees and a significant depth relative to the lobe chord length.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; numerous distinct peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in amplitude relative to the primary contour line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the outer margins of both lobes, sweeping upward and outward to sharpened, slightly hooked lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (resembling barnacle scars) scattered throughout the dark field, particularly concentrated on the medial sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, vertical linear white mark (rake mark) located on the lower inner section of the left lobe; several finer, less distinct linear disruptions visible on the upper dark region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent vertical scar on the left lobe; jagged, irregular erosion at the extreme right lateral tip suggesting old trauma or heavy colonization effects.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white 'eyebrow' shaped mottling patterns just below the top trailing edge of the left lobe.
